note: Stage 3, fifth level: borrow a ten (12 - 8). Three teaching scenes — a basket of ten plus two loose ones, a little helper carrying the ten over so it scatters into ten ones, then the vertical sum where the one in the tens place becomes zero and the two ones become twelve. Answer phase: drag the ten out of the basket, take away eight, then tap how many are left / listen and pick the matching split picture / find the wrong sentence. No self-answer during the quiz.

lines.text: Look! One ten and two ones make twelve.
Now, we need to take away eight.
But we only have two ones. That's not enough!
So, we borrow one ten from the tens!
So, twelve minus eight equals four!
When we don't have enough ones, we borrow a ten.
One ten becomes zero. And two ones become twelve.
Thirteen minus nine. Borrow a ten and take away nine.
Fifteen minus eight. Borrow a ten and take away eight.
Fourteen minus six. Borrow a ten and take away six.
Twelve minus seven. Borrow a ten and take away seven.
